scope: REF-003d: 1 ms seven-cell passive and blocked native FULL transients versus the existing Cells checked RK4 runner; numerical correspondence only
backend_clarification: The existing full runner has eager and compiled JAX paths. NumPy supplies ordinary readouts and independent arithmetic, not a third production integrator. No new NumPy stepping loop is invented for this comparison.
native_observer: Read-only sys.setprofile hook at actual FULL-loop/step/storage boundaries; no monkeypatch or substitute solver
noninterference: Every native case/profile/step is repeated without the observer; all exported ordinary and final arrays must match dtype, shape and bytes
ordinary_sample_indices: 1..N-1; raw labels k*N*dt/(N-1), elapsed after update (k+1)*dt; observer includes unsampled index 0

refinement.cross_program: matched-constant native finest step versus Cells finest step, both actual runner backends; compare increments, not large absolute inventories

failure_policy: Retain errors, incomplete coverage and failed comparisons; no automatic retry or post-result tolerance change
